name: command-toolbar-card
title: CommandToolbarCard
purpose: Stacked command launcher with consistently aligned icons, descriptions, shortcuts, and full-row actions.
avoidFor: Unrelated content forced into one surface
Pinned geometry or elevation that bypasses the active theme
accessibility: Heading level follows the surrounding document hierarchy.
Every command is a full-width native Button with visible focus and disabled behavior.
The action collection uses list semantics instead of claiming unsupported toolbar keyboard behavior.
Supporting text and status do not rely on color alone.
commonMistakes: Pinning radius, border, or shadow instead of inheriting the design context.
Replacing the typed data contract with demo-only DOM.
Adding a second principal card surface.
Returning to unequal wrapping controls that misalign labels and shortcuts.
